newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Paranagua/Santos sugar shipping conditions.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Paranagua/Santos sugar shipping conditions.

text.p: The Brazilian ports of Paranagua and Santos reported the following conditions for shipping sugar.
Vessels: Pericles loading 14,000 tonnes sugar using big bags.
Mitsa loading 19,000 tonnes bulk sugar. Waiting to dock, four vessels to load bulk sugar and two to load bagged sugar.
Road: 232 trucks carrying sugar arrived on July 10.
Loading (July 10): 2,629 tonnes using big bags, 4,645 tonnes bulk.

Vessels: Alan, Fratziz, Fulvia, Efrem, Tai Pan, Manley Exeter, Jurata and Ar Raqib each loading 14,000 tonnes bagged sugar. Anemi loading 14,000 tonnes bulk sugar. Waiting to dock, one vessel to load bulk sugar and five unspecified. At Cargill private terminal, no vessels docked or waiting to dock.
Stocks: 18,317 tonnes bulk in CODESP warehouses, no bagged sugar. Private warehouses already with bagged sugar but stock levels unavailable.
